variant.title: Anti-XV Sudoku
variant.description: Orthogonally adjacent cells may not sum to 5 or 10.
rule.anti_xv_adjacent_sum: Orthogonally adjacent cells cannot sum to 5 or 10.
rule_guide.title: Anti-XV Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Every orthogonally adjacent pair must not sum to 5 or 10.
